0022600091.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Dallas Mavericks visit the Houston Rockets, and Dallas will be without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel). Houston's Julian Phillips (illness) and Steven Adams (calf soreness) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Mavericks' most recent meeting was a 111-107 loss in Houston on January 31, 2026.
